name: read_devices
summary: Read many things in one frame: logic, slot logic, an atmosphere and reagents per item; up to 128 items and 1,024 values. A control loop's whole read per tick. Read only.

help.text: Every item is read in the same frame (one game update, not tied to the atmospherics tick). Values come back keyed by the string sent ("Pressure", "280"), never altered. include ["clock"] adds the game clock.

items.summary: What an item reads: logic, slots, atmosphere, reagents.
items.text: Each item {reference_id, logic, slots, atmosphere, reagents} needs at least one part. logic: up to 64 logic types, read as read_logic reads them. slots: up to 16 {index, logic}, slot logic as a chip's ls reads it; without logic, every slot logic type the slot reads, by the names inspect_slots gives. atmosphere: {} the id's own (a thing's internal atmosphere, a pipe's or landing pad piece's network, a pipe network id, an atmosphere id), {of: "internal"} the internal one only, or {port: n} the pipe network at that device port. reagents: true, as the reagents tool.

limits.summary: Bounds, and what makes the whole call invalid.
limits.text: At most 128 items and 1,024 values in all; a slot without logic counts 32. Over any bound, an unknown key in an item, slot or atmosphere, a name sent twice in one list, or a slot index given twice is invalid_argument, and nothing is read.

reply.text: results, per item: {index, ok, reference_id, logic {sent: value}, logic_errors {sent: {code, message}}, slots [{index, logic, logic_errors} or {index, error}], atmosphere {source, atmosphere_id, network_id, volume_l, pressure_kpa, temperature_k, total_mol, liquid_volume_l, contents [{gas, state, amount_mol, liquid_l}]}, reagents {total, reagents}, errors {part: {code, message}}}, plus count, success_count and error_count. Parts not asked and empty error maps are left out. NaN and the infinities are the strings "NaN", "Infinity" and "-Infinity".

failures.summary: How an item, a part or a value fails alone.
failures.text: An id that names nothing fails its item: {index, ok: false, reference_id, error} with thing_not_found. A part that fails whole goes into errors: device_not_found (out of scope, or not a device), no_atmosphere, port_not_joined. A value that fails goes into logic_errors with the single tools' codes: invalid_logic_type, logic_not_readable, read_failed, slot_not_found.
